title: FCM Clans
description: FCM Clans Mod adds a lightweight clan system focused on player interaction, diplomacy, and competitive wars.
body:
![fcmbg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cbcca0fdeceb101dae1ee0ef92d7c853490605f5_0.webp)

FCM Clans brings a clean, competitive, and fully player-driven clan system to Minecraft — focused on diplomacy, rivalry, and intense clan wars.

Create your clan, build your identity, and prove your dominance.

**REQUIRED MODS:**
[Luckperms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/luckperms)
[Corpse](https://modrinth.com/mod/corpse)

![fcmbg1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/857ce50da7c3fdf9e156f8a4b7aced7d9597597e.png)

🔥 Core Features
🛡️ Create Your Clan

Start your own clan and lead it your way. Build a team, manage members, and grow your influence.

📩 Join Requests

Players can apply to clans, giving leaders full control over who joins their ranks.

🎨 Full Clan Customization

Make your clan stand out:

Set a unique name
Add a custom tag
Choose an icon from any in-game item or block texture

Your clan = your style.

🤝 Diplomacy & Conflict
🕊️ Non-Aggression Pacts (NAPs)

Avoid unnecessary battles — send and accept pacts to stay neutral with other clans.

⚔️ Declare War

Ready for a fight? Declare war and settle conflicts the hard way.

🏆 Unique War System

FCM Clans features a fast-paced and fair war resolution mechanic:

Wars continue until both clans are down to one player each (1v1)
A final duel begins between the last two fighters
The duel is limited by time — no endless fights
Once it ends, the war is automatically concluded

No grinding. No drawn-out battles. Just skill.

🎮 Designed For
PvP Servers
Survival Multiplayer
Competitive Communities
